description: Manage work orders, assets, parts and locations in UpKeep.

upkeep_new_asset_trigger.description: Runs for each new asset in UpKeep. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, name, createdAt, updatedAt

upkeep_new_location_trigger.description: Runs for each new location in UpKeep. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, name, createdAt, updatedAt

upkeep_new_or_updated_asset_trigger.description: Runs for each asset added or changed in UpKeep. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, name, createdAt, updatedAt
